# Flow Fields attribution

The seeded improved-Perlin noise implementation and particle integration model
in `components/field/SpectralTracerLayer.tsx` are adapted from
[Flow Fields](https://github.com/evoluteur/flow-fields) by Olivier Giulieri,
Copyright (c) 2026, distributed under the MIT license in `LICENSE`.

The port keeps the site's two transparent Canvas layers, article obstacle masking,
responsive quality levels, and theme colours. It does not embed the upstream UI.
The rest of Nothing New retains its existing GPL-3.0-only license.
